<!-- The title becomes the squash commit subject: `type(scope): summary`, see CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

What this fixes or adds, and why, in a sentence or two.

- What changed, one bullet per logical chunk.
- Three or four bullets are enough.

Tested: the command and its result, or the test that fails when the change is reverted.

Not checked: what did not run and why, and any design choice, public API, numerics or security path that only a person can judge. "Nothing" is fine.
